author: David LaPorte
releaseNotes: TV controls are now commands (Switch, AudioVolume and MediaInputSource, plus picture, sound and power commands), so Rule Machine, dashboards, HomeKit, voice assistants and Maker API can use them; the controls left the Preferences page. New picture, sound, light sensor, remote battery and TV temperature attributes. switch and screen go off when the TV can't be reached. A value a command sets is held briefly against a read-back that lags, picture readings keep their values while the TV is in standby, and a power command the TV doesn't follow within 2 minutes logs a warning. After updating, click Initialize on the TV device (it removes the old control settings). If the TV is in Hubitat's HomeKit integration, press Restart integration there. Requires Hubitat 2.2.9+.
